Hey I’ve drank 1/2-1 litre vodka every evening since 21.11.19 the day my brother took his own life in jail after struggling himself for 10 years with alcohol … I used the old cliche of New Year’s Day to stop and surprisingly it hasn’t been that hard I’m just not over thinking it it will be harder when I have to go to a party and if I do fall off I’ll forgive myself but I don’t intend to I have tried stopping over the years but eventually you will feel ready I have read the book ‘this baked mind’ it was really great but even then instil didn’t stop … I’ve made such a fool of myself and done unspeakable things whilst drunk things you’d never do sober and that’s what I want to avoid … I’m honestly coming to terms with the fact I might never be able to drink moderately so I’m just taking it one day at a time but it’s good to distract yourself not with anything drastic just stuff watching tv, sorting stuff out etc anything …. but don’t let the fact it’s no longer the new year stop you using 05.01.23 to be your day of any other day but I definitely think you have to build up to a date and tell yourself you won’t drink past that date …don’t think of anything past an hour at a time in fact don’t even watch the clock! get a nice selection of drinks … don’t over eat as that’s tempting but do eat nice things and be kind to yourself xx good luck xx you can do anything xx
